root_cause.text: In iomap_finish_folio_read(), the error reporting call to fserror_report_io() using folio->mapping->host is placed after decrementing ifs->read_bytes_pending, which can allow a concurrent final read completion to unlock the folio and truncation to clear folio->mapping, resulting in a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message details the race: CPU0 (failed completion) decrements read_bytes_pending and is preempted before reporting the error; CPU1 (final completion) then decrements to zero, calls folio_end_read() (unlocking the folio), allowing truncate to clear folio->mapping; CPU0 then dereferences folio->mapping->host, which is NULL. The patch fixes this by moving the error reporting before the decrement of read_bytes_pending. The patch diff shows the reordering.

intent_record.intent_summary: Report I/O errors during folio read completion via fserror_report_io.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional call to fserror_report_io inside iomap_finish_folio_read that reports buffered read errors with the inode, position, length, error code, and GFP_ATOMIC flag when error is non-zero.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when an error occurs during folio read completion, the error is now reported to the filesystem error tracking mechanism, ensuring that I/O errors for buffered reads are not silently ignored.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove error reporting from iomap_finish_folio_read to prevent redundant or incorrect error logging.
intent_record.what: Removed a conditional block in iomap_finish_folio_read that called fserror_report_io with FSERR_BUFFERED_READ when error was non-zero.
intent_record.how: Previously, an I/O error during read would be reported via fserror_report_io; now that reporting is omitted, potentially altering filesystem error tracking behavior.
